name: beat_this
note: Beat This! (CPJKU, ISMIR 2024), the authors' own final0 checkpoint exported by build/beat_this_wgsl/export_weights.py --f16: BatchNorms and RMSNorm gammas folded, matmul weights fp16, everything else fp32, the tensor manifest packed into the same file. One file for both runtimes: the WebGPU path in the renderer (src/services/analysis/beatThisWgsl), for automix and 智能动感模式 alike, and the CPU fallback in the analysis worker, which builds the network over these tensors in MNN (native/folia-mnn/folia_beat_this.cpp). Beat and downbeat lists identical to the onnxruntime export on the seven test tracks, on both.
